Mrs. Fisher: You caught an impressive largemouth bass. They are quite common, but by far they are the most sought after fish from the sunfish family.
Mrs. Fisher: They are from the same family as bluegills, smallmouth bass and crappies, although you won't catch any crappies around here.
You: Are they any good?
Mrs. Fisher: What? Crappies? They are panfish, similar in taste to bluegills, but their meat is softer and in my opinion a little bland.
Mrs. Fisher: You are not missing out, trust me.
You: Got it.
